# Authored map marker checks

Mount `scripts/Game` temporarily under the Workbench profile's `scripts/Game/MapMarkerChecks`, reload and start disposable Arland Play. Call `GC_LobbyManager.GC_TestMapMarkers(false, false)` on `GC_MissionTemplate` for catalog, audience and actual widget readback. The boolean arguments open/close the active spectator map through its production handler. `GC_TestFullscreenMarkers()` opens the native fullscreen map menu. Use real self-selection and authenticated phase requests for audience/phase changes. Remove the verified junction and reload when finished.

2026-11-14, Workbench 1.9.0.37: before fix, session `logs_2026-11-14_09-56-06` logged rejection of both unnamed authored markers. Workbench's generated hierarchy labels were not runtime entity names. After fix, operation `e4e8f3f10565445b854142492ef87811` found three registered markers (the user added Objective during work), two eligible/visible widgets for the unfactioned preview. The actual map capture showed US Army Spawn and Objective above the AO overlay. After selecting USSR slot 10 and advancing to briefing, operation `f5f59d9f4fd8470694a0594dc299eaff` found three eligible/visible widgets including RU Spawn, with positive image dimensions. User confirmed fixed.

Independent review identified a hover-reset stacking issue; the corrected layout now supplies z-order 2 before the widget handler caches its baseline, above AO fill at 1. Final implementation compiled with no script errors (operation `880752c0efec4970ad9ed1fa39a8b432`); unrelated existing world-resource GUID diagnostics remain. Review approved. Spectator/fullscreen, explicit hover-leave, entity-deletion cleanup, reconnect and remote multiplayer were not exercised to completion. These remain coverage gaps, not passing assertions.
